message.content: {"scores":{"c1":10,"c2":10,"c3":10},"evidence":"The isinstance checks reject floats. Checking the docstring examples: (5,2,7) gives 5+2=7, so True. (3,2,2) gives False. (3,-2,1) gives -2+1=-1≠3 but 3+(-2)=1=z, so True. (3.6,-2.2,2) gives False. All three sum permutations are covered, so zeros and negatives are handled correctly, e.g. (0,0,0) is True and (0,1,1) is True. The body is valid Python with correct indentation, always returns a bool, and has no crash paths. Bools would pass the isinstance(int) check, but this is a negligible edge case."}
